title: Existence of two disjoint sets of equal size
statement: Let $n$ and $t$ be natural numbers with $2t \le n$. Then there exist two disjoint subsets $A, B \subseteq \{1, \dots, n\}$, each of cardinality $t$.
replaced:
Whenever $2t \le n$, there exist disjoint finsets $A, B \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$ with
$|A| = |B| = t$.
